facts.fact: The Minister told the ITU WTDC-25 on 2025-11-18 that the government is implementing an infrastructure agenda of nationwide fibre expansion aiming for full coverage by 2027, with over 1,500 villages connected and 3,000 to go through universal service programmes, so the period had not ended.
